annotations.title: Spiegel mit & ohne Rahmen finden Sie bei Höffner online
Spiegel kaufen » Jetzt im ROLLER Online-Shop

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog retailer** in the U.S., it does **not appear to have an active official Spiegel Home online catalog** today. Spiegel was historically a catalog retailer that sold apparel and home goods, but the classic catalog-shopping business is largely defunct. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you mean **shopping for home mirrors** — “Spiegel” means **mirror** in German — current online options include:

- **home24 mirrors** ([home24.de](https://www.home24.de/alle-spiegel//?utm_source=openai))  
- **Westwing mirrors** ([westwing.de](https://www.westwing.de/spiegel/wandspiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Höffner mirrors** ([hoeffner.de](https://www.hoeffner.de/garderoben-spiegel?utm_source=openai))  
- **ROLLER mirrors** ([roller.de](https://www.roller.de/moebel/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Nielsen Design Shop mirrors** ([nielsen-shop.de](https://www.nielsen-shop.de/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  

If you’re looking for **vintage Spiegel catalogs**, try searching eBay, Etsy, Internet Archive, or vintage catalog collector sites.
